subject: Vendor onboarding: COI endorsement details, W-9 DocuSign, and remit/TIN
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@ecosupply.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2027-10-04T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding evidence & COI endorsement wording request

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for signing up to be a Redwood supplier. To finish vendor activation and issue a purchase order we need the certificate of insurance (COI) with the following items in place:

- Waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference (Redwood Inference, Inc.).
- Additional insured endorsement that specifically lists: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents" and covers products/completed operations for two years.
- Cyber liability limits as agreed in the SOW (minimum $2M).

I attached our COI_Specs.pdf and the Vendor_Onboarding_Form.docx for fields we need populated. Additionally, can you complete the W-9 via DocuSign (I included a link below) and confirm the remit address and TIN/EIN for PO billing? Once we receive the COI + signed W-9 we can proceed with a conditional PO.

If any of the endorsement language is a problem for your carrier, please flag which part — we can discuss conditional acceptance paths (e.g., temporary PO hold with remediation plan).

Appreciate a rough ETA; we hope to have this completed by EOD Wednesday so procurement can queue the PO.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_COI_Specs.pdf, Vendor_Onboarding_Form.docx
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/ABC-1234-ES-W9

From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@ecosupply.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procure-support@ecosupply.com
Date: 2027-10-04T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding evidence & COI endorsement wording request

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear checklist and the materials. Attached is our current COI (EcoSupply_COI.pdf) and a completed W-9 we signed through DocuSign (EcoSupply_signed_W9_Docusign.pdf).

A couple of quick items:
- Our broker indicated they can add Redwood as additional insured and waive subrogation, but they prefer adding Redwood by legal entity and business address rather than the full "officers, directors" phrase. Is that acceptable?
- For products/completed operations we can propose a 12-month completed ops window instead of two years; our policy only supports two years with an additional premium.

If you confirm the exact wording you need for the endorsement, we can request the carrier endorsement and re-issue. ETA from the broker is 2–3 business days once wording is finalized.

Remit/TIN details are included in the signed W-9. Remit address: 1245 Harbor Way, Suite 200, Portland, OR 97205.

Elena
Head of Operations
EcoSupply Inc.

Attachments: EcoSupply_COI.pdf, EcoSupply_signed_W9_Docusign.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@ecosupply.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2027-10-04T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding evidence & COI endorsement wording request

Elena —

Thanks for sending everything so quickly and for the broker ETA. Two clarifications from procurement before we lock wording:

1) Additional insured phrasing: we can accept the company/legal-entity style phrasing but need it to explicitly include coverage for products/completed operations and name Redwood Inference, Inc. as the additional insured. Example: "Redwood Inference, Inc., 410 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107, is included as Additional Insured for products and completed operations."

2) Completed operations duration: our standard is 24 months, but we can accept 12 months on a case-by-case basis with a conditional PO that includes a remediation timeline to reach 24 months (carrier amendment or extended coverage within 90 days). If you elect 12 months, please confirm broker's willingness for a 90-day remediation window and whether that will incur additional premium.

Marcus, can you confirm the minimal legal endorsement text we should require (we prefer to avoid bespoke drafting where possible).

Thanks — Neha
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@ecosupply.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding evidence & COI endorsement wording request

On Tue, Oct 4, 2027 at 11:07 AM Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Marcus, can you confirm the minimal legal endorsement text we should require (we prefer to avoid bespoke drafting where possible).

Hi all —

Quick legal note: the procurement team request in Neha's email is appropriate. For carriers that resist the long-form roster of officers/directors, the following endorsement language is acceptable and standard from a legal perspective:

"It is hereby understood and agreed that 'Redwood Inference, Inc., 410 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107' is included as an Additional Insured with respect to liability arising out of the Named Insured's products and completed operations. Waiver of Subrogation applies in favor of Redwood Inference, Inc. where permitted by law."

Please ensure the cyber liability limit of $2,000,000 is reflected on the face of the COI or via a separate cyber policy declaration. If EcoSupply can accept the above endorsement text and confirm the remediation window for completed operations (if they initially provide 12 months), procurement can issue a conditional PO while the broker finalizes the endo.

Marcus
General Counsel (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>

Subject: Re: Onboarding evidence & COI endorsement wording request

Elena —

Thanks — that endorsement language from Marcus is perfect. If your broker can update the COI to reflect the additional insured line exactly as provided and note the cyber limit, we will proceed with a conditional PO (PO# RDW-2027-5587) and grant a 90-day remediation window to amend completed operations to 24 months if needed.

Next steps:
- Please have the broker re-issue the COI with the endorsement and waiver of subrogation as quoted.
- Upload the revised COI to our vendor portal: https://redwood.procure/portal/vendors/ES-4821 and reply to this thread when done.
- Once uploaded and verified by procurement, PO RDW-2027-5587 will be released and invoicing can begin to the remit address noted on the W-9.

If there are any issues with the DocuSign W-9 we already received, procurement will follow up — otherwise we're set to move forward when the COI is updated.

Welcome aboard and looking forward to working together.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
